purpose: Contract for the demo console to render AgentLoop/OTel GenAI traces for PR #1 / PR #2

query_api.semantics: filters match attributes.agentteams.* ; parent-child tree always rendered from root_span

rendering.parent_child: tree by parent_span_id; timestamps are ORIGINAL evidence times (UTC ms precision); time_certainty flag shown when 'inferred'

panels.result_evaluation: reads result_evaluation block inside each result-trace file (kept separate from trajectory_evaluation_ref)
panels.human_gate: reads human-gate-trace.json: request -> blocking_window -> approval; renders blocking window as a hard pause bar on the timeline
panels.integrity: renders canonical_sha256 from each trace + stability-180s.json probe results

redaction_display: show body_sha12 + body_len + body_head40 only; console MUST NOT attempt to reconstruct bodies
mode_badge: console must display a persistent 'EVIDENCE REPLAY' badge (mode=evidence-replay); live-capture presentation is prohibited
